compositionRows.assumption: The acknowledgement identifies the exact profile/project/version requested.
compositionRows.mechanism: Captured snapshot project.id is compared to the entry id; revision-safe Save checks active project before and after persistence.
gaps: Latest revision identity after asynchronous flush is not independently proven by these checks.

compositionRows.assumption: The committed workflow requires project write then Library index acknowledgement.
compositionRows.mechanism: persistActiveProfileProject awaits save-project and then sync-library-index; authorityEpoch checked at each boundary.
gaps: Separate writes are not atomic; interruption between them needs reconciliation proof.

compositionRows.assumption: A queued mutation retains the authenticated owner and cannot adopt another profile.
compositionRows.mechanism: queueWriteOperation and authorityEpoch fences; migration gateway takes currentProfileRequestContext, not browser owner input.
gaps: Observe concurrent profile change/revocation at storage boundary; caller fencing alone cannot certify it.

compositionRows.assumption: Retries preserve original operation/content and cannot duplicate effective writes or external actions.
compositionRows.mechanism: Browser deduplicates matching captured pending snapshots and acknowledges project snapshots; migration journal skips recorded completed identities.
gaps: In-memory coalescing is not a durable operation-id deduplication guarantee; write-before-journal interruption and multi-process races need real proof.

compositionRows.assumption: Confirmed Save supports same-profile/device recovery while underlying encrypted data and media remain present.
compositionRows.mechanism: Encrypted profile readback and legacy migration snapshots provide bounded local mechanisms.
gaps: No remote backup guarantee follows from local storage; device-loss recovery is an unmet stronger assumption.

migrationRows.assumption: Every migrated record retains canonical data identity.
migrationRows.mechanism: migrateLegacyProfile rejects duplicate project ids and project.id mismatches; inventory must match resumed journal.
gaps: Exact full bytes after interruption and replay still need independent recovery comparison.

migrationRows.assumption: Representation conversion preserves logical content, source identity and unsupported information.
migrationRows.mechanism: Migration copies item.value through saveProjectInternal and checks readback existence.
gaps: Non-null readback is weaker than equality of all logical content; no blanket lossless conversion certification.

migrationRows.assumption: Legacy ownership transfers to one authenticated Human profile.
migrationRows.mechanism: withMutation uses authenticated access; gateway assignment marker rejects another profile; source is set read-only.
gaps: Gateway queue is process-local; concurrent processes and marker interruption remain unobserved.

migrationRows.assumption: Interrupted migration can recover original data and resume without losing unrelated records.
migrationRows.mechanism: Snapshot is created before journal; migratedProjects/migratedCredentials support resumption.
gaps: Snapshot restore with actual project/media bytes and damaged journal needs real observation.

migrationRows.assumption: Old code can read migrated representation or an independently verified data recovery path exists.
migrationRows.mechanism: Snapshot id is retained by the migration journal.
gaps: No old-reader compatibility or exercised restore follows from merely storing a snapshot id.

migrationRows.assumption: Old/new executions never duplicate real writes or external actions.
migrationRows.mechanism: Source read-only transition precedes inventory; journal completion skips already recorded records.
gaps: Mutation before journal update can replay; this does not prove exactly-once external effects.

migrationRows.assumption: Retire an adapter only after consumers/data responsibilities transfer with required evidence.
migrationRows.mechanism: Architecture exception names lib/pageflow.ts, canonical modules/build/pageflow.ts, issue 1466 and two remaining route consumers.
gaps: Bridge still has consumers; do not remove it or treat historical retirement tests as current product confirmation.
